svg.title: The warehouse only ships after the customer's payment clears
svg.desc: Activity diagram with 3 partitions: Customer, Sales, Warehouse. Start (Customer). Place order (Customer). Pay (Customer). Check payment (Sales). Payment cleared? (Sales) [yes]: pack order (Warehouse) (step 6). [no]: cancel order (Sales) (step 7). Pack order (Warehouse). Cancel order (Sales). Ship order (Warehouse). End of this path (Sales). End (Customer).
